user.title: Add a station
user.description:
Search for the station you travel from. Every station is listed once per departure board: **S-tog** for the Copenhagen S-trains and **Tog** for regional and long-distance trains. Big stations such as København H have both.

You can also type the station code from the mittog.dk address, e.g. VNG from mittog.dk/da/departures/VNG/stog/, and choose "Add custom item".

direction.title: Direction from {station}
direction.description:
Which way are you going? These are the directions trains leave {station} in, named after where they are going right now ({count} departures on the board). Trains that turn back early (e.g. at Svanemøllen instead of Klampenborg) are still included.

Add the station again later to follow the other direction too.

filters.title: Filters for {station}
filters.description: All optional. The lists only contain what runs from {station} in the direction you picked. Leave a field empty to keep every train.

data_description.towards: Only trains that stop at one of these stations, e.g. to skip trains that end before your stop.
data_description.lines: Only these lines (A, B, C …) or train types (Re, IC, ICL …).
data_description.tracks: Only trains leaving from these tracks.
data_description.max_departures: How many upcoming departures are kept in the departures attribute.
data_description.delay_threshold: The disruption sensor turns on when a shown train is this late (or cancelled).
data_description.hide_cancelled: Leave cancelled trains out entirely instead of flagging them.

error.unknown_station: Unknown station. Pick one from the list.
error.towards_self: A station cannot be a stop on its own departures.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach mittog.dk. Try again in a moment.

abort.already_configured: This station is already added with this direction and these filters.
